headline: Carrd: Build a simple one-page website
body: Create a professional-looking landing page, portfolio, or "coming soon" site quickly, even without tech skills.
caption:
Need a simple online home for your work or business, but don't want a big, complex website? Carrd lets you build a clean, responsive one-page site in minutes. It's great for portfolios, linking to your social media, or a quick launch page. Their free plan gives you access to core features. Remember to check their website for the most current free plan details. Get building! ✨
